items.title: Tata Trusts meet: SDTT approves over ₹150 crore in grants for 5 initiatives
items.rss_summary: The Sir Dorabji Tata Trust approved over Rs 150 crore in grants to five initiatives, including Rs 50 crore to a hospital in Pune led by Jehangir H C Jehangir, who has been associated with other Tata Trusts. All the proposals at the meeting chaired by Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata, and also attended by Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh, people aware of the matter said. There was no discussion at the meeting on any of the other issues within the Tata group dominating the headlines, they said. Amid questions raised over a grant being made to an entity with whom Jehangir, a trustee of the Sir Ratan Tata Trusts, is associated, a source asserted that there is "no conflict of interest" in this case. Pune's Jehangir Hospital, which is promoted by the Cowasji Jehangir Trust counts on Jehangir HC Jehangir as the chief executive.
